name: LimX Dynamics
summary: LimX Dynamics is an embodied intelligent robot manufacturer focused on the development, production and commercialization of general-purpose robots. Its products include the fully autonomous LimX Oli and LimX Luna humanoids and the modular TRON robot series. The company pursues disruptive Physical AI innovation through three core technologies: original robot hardware design and manufacturing, integrated high-level intelligence and motion control, and the COSA humanoid brain system. It is also building an open ecosystem for developers worldwide and open-sourcing infrastructure for training embodied models to unlock AGI's ability to generalize in the physical world. Looking ahead, LimX Dynamics will continue developing next-generation intelligent robots for research, commercial services and industrial manufacturing, with the eventual aim of bringing them into households.
